This tool allows users to track daily sales for their products and their competitors’ products. It provides a clear overview of the units sold and estimated revenue.

With AMZ Tracker, retailers may enhance their product listings with an on-page optimization tool. This tool analyzes the title, meta description, bullet points, and keywords. It suggests improvements to increase your visibility and conversion rate.

You will receive a notification whenever a customer leaves a negative review on your product. This feature lets you quickly address customer issues, prevent negative feedback, and improve product ratings.
